are_you_ok.title: H-E-B jalapeño product recall includes guacamole, prepared foods and more over salmonella concerns
are_you_ok.summary: Dozens of products made in-store by H-E-B, the San Antonio-based grocery chain that dominates Texas, were also removed because they contained items impacted by the recall.
questions: Did you have any of the recalled H-E-B items in your fridge?
Is everyone in your house doing all right?
are_you_ok.description: Dozens of H-E-B products made in stores were also removed because they contained items impacted by the recall.
